quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #16
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: Which drugs can affect your ability to drive?

options.text: Allergy medicine
Marijuana
Cold remedies
All of these choices

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these choices
questions.explanation: Many drugs can affect your driving. This includes illegal drugs and legal prescription or over-the-counter medicines. Driving while impaired by any drug is a crime.

questions.question: A child under age eight and shorter than ____ must sit in an approved child safety seat while the car is moving.

options.text: 5 feet, 5 inches
5 feet
4 feet, 11 inches
4 feet, 9 inches

questions.correctAnswerText: 4 feet, 9 inches
questions.explanation: The law requires children under age eight and shorter than 4 feet, 9 inches tall to use an approved child safety seat. They should not use a regular seat belt until it fits them properly.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your reflexes and reaction time slow down.
Your judgment of speed and distance becomes distorted.
You are less alert.
You calm down and concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, makes it harder to see clearly, distorts your judgment of speed and distance, reduces recovery from headlight glare, and makes you more likely to take risks.

questions.question: If you are parked parallel to the curb, you can only get out on the traffic side when:

options.text: It is daytime and other drivers can see you.
The traffic light at the nearest intersection turns red.
You will not interfere with oncoming vehicles.
You turn on your four-way flashers first.

questions.correctAnswerText: You will not interfere with oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Do not open your door if it will block traffic or cyclists. Always check for traffic before you exit your vehicle.

questions.question: Strong wind gusts on highways:

options.text: Generally only affect large vehicles.
Only cause visibility problems.
Can cause problems for all vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can cause problems for all vehicles.
questions.explanation: Strong wind affects all drivers, not just large vehicles. Wind can reduce visibility by blowing dust and dirt onto the road, and it can physically push any vehicle across lanes.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, you should drive at:

options.text: About the same speed as freeway traffic.
The legal speed limit.
A slower speed than freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: About the same speed as freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Merge onto the freeway at about the same speed as the traffic, unless the traffic is going faster than the legal speed limit.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection, you should:

options.text: Stop before crossing.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Wait for a green light before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, look for cross traffic, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, you should:

options.text: Speed up to reach your destination faster.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Stay farther behind the car ahead.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther behind the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car in front of you.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No right turn.
Stop sign ahead.
Divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: To make a right turn, your car should be positioned:

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection before you start turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Before making a right turn, move as far to the right side of the road as possible. Do not cross other lanes of traffic to make any turn.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A green arrow:

options.text: Is used only on one-way streets.
Means the same as a circular green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
Means you may proceed only if a circular green light is also showing.
Points the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: Means the same as a circular green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means the same as a circular green light. However, traffic in that lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach an intersection with a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Come to a full stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. You should:

options.text: Slam on your brakes.
Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down gradually.
Keep driving normally.
Turn on emergency flashers and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not brake immediately when a tire blows out. Grip the steering wheel tightly to stay in your lane. Slow down gradually by releasing the accelerator. Once you are moving slowly, apply the brakes lightly and pull to a safe area off the road.

questions.question: Bicyclists differ from motorists in that they are not required to:

options.text: Obey the same traffic laws.
Signal all turns.
Report accidents that cause serious injury.
Have insurance for the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have insurance for the bicycle.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists must obey the same traffic laws as drivers. Any bicycle crash that causes death or serious injury must be reported to the DMV within 10 days.

questions.question: You face a green light but traffic blocks the intersection ahead. You should:

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Stay out of the intersection until traffic clears.
Follow other vehicles and enter the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until traffic clears.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if traffic blocks it, even if your light is green. If you enter and get stuck when the light turns red, you block other traffic. You can receive a ticket for blocking an intersection.

questions.question: A solid yellow line and a broken yellow line mark the road, with the broken line next to your lane. You may pass:

options.text: Only in an emergency.
If you are on an expressway.
If the road ahead is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: When a solid yellow line is paired with a broken yellow line and the broken line is on your side, you may cross the lines to pass if no vehicles are coming toward you.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: Must not pass another vehicle.
May pass a slow vehicle if you can do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. Drivers must follow all instructions on regulatory signs. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Curves ahead.
Divided highway starts.
Divided highway ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Get ready to change lanes or move your position.

questions.question: When making a right turn on a green light, you must:

options.text: Keep your normal driving speed.
Stop and check for nearby police cars.
Let pedestrians cross first.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: You may turn right or left on a steady green light unless a sign says otherwise. When turning, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: You approach an intersection where you cannot see clearly to the side. You should:

options.text: Slow down and look both ways.
Keep your speed and look both ways.
Stop, then move forward slowly until you can see both directions clearly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then move forward slowly until you can see both directions clearly.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach an intersection. If you cannot see clearly, stop completely. Move forward slowly until you can see traffic in both directions.
